name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) Open-Face Roast Turkey Sandwich & Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: One of the most restorative comfort meals in Logan! Lean roast turkey breast, soft bread, smooth mashed potatoes, and mild gravy require minimal digestive effort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Turkey Sandwich with mashed potatoes and gravy; request no cranberry sauce if avoiding fruit seeds.
